points.description: States that a function signature includes the name of the function (the function identifier). Accept equivalent wording such as 'the function's name' or 'what the function is called'.
points.partial_credit: All-or-nothing: the answer must identify the function name/identifier.

points.description: States that a function signature includes the types of the parameters (the parameter type list). Accept equivalent wording such as 'the data types of its arguments/inputs'.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if the answer mentions parameters or arguments but does not say their types are included.

levels.says: Mentions parameters/arguments but not their types, e.g. 'the parameters'.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both components from the model answer: the function name and the parameter types. Part marks are available for mentioning parameters without their types. Unrelated items such as the function body do not earn marks; the model answer does not include a return type, so it is not required.
